summary.basis: Bundled inventory reconciled with a read-only snapshot of published production content; see cmsReconciliation. Live HTTP/rendering verification remains separate.
summary.note: Flags are review candidates, not proven errors. References checked do not certify article contents. Fingerprints identify the reviewed snapshot; no reviewed status is inherited by changed CMS content.

amounts.label: Government Gazette 54397, notice R.7287 — grant amounts
amounts.scope: Maximum ordinary-grant amounts from April 2026 and the Foster Child increase from October 2026. The enacted notice resolves differences from the earlier budget reporting.

srdAmount.label: SAnews: SRD amount and extension, 25 February 2026
srdAmount.scope: SRD remains R370 under the published extension to 31 March 2027. For ordinary-grant amounts, use the later Gazette notice rather than this budget report.

contacts.label: SASSA Services: regional contact listings
contacts.scope: Listed regional addresses, enquiry telephone numbers and emails were compared with this page. Other government directories list different addresses for some regions; confirm with the office before travelling. Map pins are approximate.

directory.label: South African Government: SASSA directory
directory.scope: National enquiry contact and head-office address. Regional manager entries can differ from the Services portal's public enquiry listings.

child.label: South African Government: Child Support Grant
child.scope: Caregiver, child age, residence and document guidance. Numeric means-test thresholds differ across official publications and are not certified by this review.

disability.label: South African Government: Disability Grant
disability.scope: Age range and medical-assessment guidance. Numeric means-test thresholds require a separate current determination.

grants.label: SASSA Services: grants information
grants.scope: Official reference for grant-specific requirements. The grant requirements page was checked directly. Numeric means-test thresholds are outside this check; linked historical brochures must not supply current amounts.

srd.label: SASSA: official SRD portal
srd.scope: Official route for SRD information and account actions. Individual decisions and payment dates must be checked there; this guide is not an official status result.

appeals.label: DSD: Independent Tribunal SRD appeals
appeals.scope: SRD appeal instructions. Some background text on the portal describes an earlier grant period; do not treat its historic income threshold as current. Check the instructions and decision notice for the month concerned.

banking.label: SASSA: SRD banking-update instructions
banking.scope: Registered-mobile verification, beneficiary-owned bank accounts and future use of new details after verification. These instructions apply to SRD; they do not establish a universal bank-clearing time.

cmsReconciliation.mode: Read-only public content snapshot; no personal tables or database writes
